column1: # input.tsv -- the remapping this setup does below the compositor.
# One row, and it exists because a keyboard lied about one of its keys: the MX
# Keys sends the Windows snipping chord where PrtSc belongs, and no setting on
# the keyboard can change it. See input/keyd/mx-keys.conf for the whole story
#         Written with `install -Dm644` as root, the same way a browser policy
#         is: keyd reads /etc/keyd before anyone logs in, so a symlink into a
#         home directory is not a thing to put there. The destination must be
#         /etc/keyd/*.conf -- keyd loads nothing else, and tests/lint.sh
#         manifest-sources says so rather than letting the file be ignored.
# Paths starting with ~ are relative to HOME; everything else is absolute, and
# both are prefixed by --root when one is given.
